Imagine training an AI model without painstakingly defining every connection. What if, instead of programming architectures, we could coax them into existence? At its core, this approach uses structured randomness to grow neural networks. Think of it like planting a seed and letting it sprout. Instead of pre-wiring every neuron, we start with a minimal initial state. Then, through carefully controlled 'noise' – random fluctuations – a layered network organically assembles itself.
